about: Netflix is the world's largest subscription video streaming service, with over 300 million paying members in more than 190 countries, offering original series and films (Stranger Things, Squid Game), licensed content, live events and games, and an advertising tier. Revenue near 45 billion dollars. Headquartered in Los Gatos, California; founded 1997. Listed on Nasdaq (NFLX). Global household brand, and a partner of major live sports such as boxing, NFL Christmas games and the Formula 1 Drive to Survive series.

wiki.title: Netflix
wiki.text: Netflix is an American subscription video on-demand over-the-top streaming media service. The service primarily distributes original and acquired films and television shows from various genres. It is available internationally in multiple languages. Launched in 2007, nearly a decade after Netflix, Inc. began its pioneering DVD-by-mail movie rental service, Netflix is the most-subscribed video on demand global streaming media service, with 325 million paid memberships in more than 190 countries as of 2026. By 2022, "Netflix Original" productions accounted for half of its library in the United States and the namesake company had ventured into ot

wiki.title: Netflix, Inc.
wiki.text: Netflix, Inc. is an American media company founded on August 29, 1997, by Reed Hastings and Marc Randolph in Scotts Valley, California, and currently based in Los Gatos, California, with production offices and stages at the Los Angeles–based Hollywood studios (formerly old Warner Brothers studios) and the Albuquerque Studios (formerly ABQ studios). It owns and operates an eponymous over-the-top subscription video on-demand service, which showcases acquired and original programming as well as third-party content licensed from other production companies and distributors. Netflix is also the first streaming media company to be a member of the Mo

about: Apple is a Cupertino, California technology company that designs iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, AirPods, Apple TV and Vision Pro, runs the App Store, and sells services such as iCloud, Apple Music, Apple TV+, Apple Pay and AppleCare. It sells to consumers and businesses worldwide through its own stores, online and carriers, with annual revenue near $400bn and about 160,000 employees. Listed on Nasdaq (AAPL) and among the world's most valuable companies. Among the most recognised consumer brands; F1 US broadcast rights from 2026, and a major marketing partner.

wiki.title: Apple
wiki.text: An apple is the round, edible fruit of an apple tree (Malus spp.). Fruit trees of the orchard or domestic apple (Malus domestica), the most widely grown in the genus, are cultivated worldwide. The tree originated in Central Asia, where its wild ancestor, Malus sieversii, is still found. Apples have been grown for thousands of years in Eurasia before they were introduced to the American continent by European colonists. Apples have cultural significance in many mythologies (including Norse and Greek) and religions (such as Christianity in Europe). Apples grown from seeds tend to be very different from those of their parents, and the resultant f

wiki.title: Apple Inc.
wiki.text: Apple Inc. is an American multinational technology company headquartered in Cupertino, California, in Silicon Valley, and known for consumer electronics, software and online services. Founded in 1976 as Apple Computer Company by Steve Jobs, Steve Wozniak and Ronald Wayne, the company was incorporated by Jobs and Wozniak as Apple Computer, Inc. the following year. Its current name was adopted in 2007 as the company expanded its focus from computers to consumer electronics. Apple is one of the Big Tech companies. The company was founded to market Wozniak's Apple I computer. Its successor, the Apple II, became one of the first successful mass-pr

about: Canal+ Group is a French pay-television and film company running the Canal+ premium channels, themed channels, streaming services and the StudioCanal production and distribution arm. It serves millions of subscribers in France, Africa, Poland, Vietnam and elsewhere, earning revenue from subscriptions, advertising and content. It was historically part of Vivendi, was spun off and listed on the London Stock Exchange in December 2024, and has been acquiring MultiChoice in South Africa. It is a well known consumer media brand and a major sports rights holder.

Goodman Group is an Australian industrial property group based in Sydney that owns, develops and manages logistics warehouses, business parks and increasingly data centers in Australia, New Zealand, Asia, Europe, the UK, North America and the Middle East. It manages billions of dollars of assets for institutional investors and earns development and fees income. Listed on the ASX (GMG). B2B real estate firm with no consumer brand awareness.

wiki.title: Goodman Group
wiki.text: Goodman Group is a provider of essential infrastructure. It owns, develops and manages real estate. This includes warehouses, large scale logistics facilities, business and office parks and data centers globally.

about: International Distribution Services is the parent of Royal Mail and General Logistics Systems (GLS), a London-based postal and parcel group delivering letters and parcels in the UK and across Europe and Canada. It had revenue over GBP 12bn and about 140,000 employees. In 2025 it was acquired by Czech billionaire Daniel Kretinsky's EP Group for about GBP 3.6bn and delisted from the London Stock Exchange. Royal Mail is a very well-known UK consumer brand.

wiki.title: International Distribution Services
wiki.text: International Distribution Services Limited is a British company providing postal and courier services. IDS was created in 2013 by the UK government as a new holding company of Royal Mail, and a majority of its shares were then sold on the London Stock Exchange, with the government initially retaining a 30 per cent at the time. As of April 2025, IDS is owned and operated by Czech-based EP Group, owned by Daniel Křetínský.

about: Mitsui & Co is a Tokyo-based general trading company (sogo shosha), one of Japan's big five, founded 1876 and active in energy, metals, machinery, chemicals, food, healthcare and mobility. It makes money by trading, project investments and equity-accounted businesses, with operations in about 60 countries and tens of thousands of staff. Listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (8031). Customers are corporates and governments; B2B, brand known in business and Japan but little consumer recognition.

wiki.title: Mitsui & Co.
wiki.text: Mitsui & Co., Ltd. is a Japanese general trading company and a core member of the Mitsui Group. For much of the post-war period, Mitsui & Co. has been among the largest of the five great sogo shosha by revenue as well as profits.

about: Aramex is a Dubai-based logistics and express delivery company founded in 1982, offering courier, freight forwarding, warehousing and e-commerce fulfilment across the Middle East, Africa, Asia and beyond. Customers are businesses and online shoppers. Revenue is about 1.5 billion dollars, with an AED 2 billion funding figure reported in the input. Listed on the Dubai Financial Market (ARMX); Abu Dhabi's Abu Dhabi Ports (AD Ports) became majority owner of Aramex in 2025. Visible brand in the Gulf.

wiki.title: Aramex
wiki.text: Aramex is an Emirati multinational logistics, courier and package delivery company based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. The company was founded by Fadi Ghandour and Bill Kingson in 1982 in Amman, Jordan.

about: JD Logistics is the logistics arm of JD.com, headquartered in Beijing and listed in Hong Kong (2618) since 2021. It provides warehousing, express delivery, freight and supply chain technology to JD.com and external clients across China and overseas, with hundreds of warehouses and over 500,000 staff including couriers. Revenue is above 150 billion yuan, mainly from logistics services. Founded 2007 inside JD.com. Strong consumer-facing brand in China through deliveries, though largely B2B abroad.

wiki.title: JD Logistics
wiki.text: JD Logistics (JDL), also known as JINGDONG Logistics is a Chinese supply chain management and logistics company. It is a subsidiary of JD.com.

about: UPS (United Parcel Service) is the world's largest package delivery company, headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia and listed on the NYSE (UPS). It delivers around 20 million packages a day across more than 200 countries and territories with about 500,000 employees, a large delivery fleet and aircraft, plus supply chain, freight and healthcare logistics. Revenue is around 90 billion dollars. Founded 1907. Very strong consumer and business brand with a history of sports sponsorship, including NASCAR.

wiki.title: United Parcel Service
wiki.text: United Parcel Service, Inc. (UPS) is an American multinational shipping-and-receiving and supply chain management company founded in 1907. Originally known as the American Messenger Company specializing in telegraphs, UPS has expanded to become a Fortune 500 company and one of the world's largest shipping couriers. UPS today is primarily known for its ground shipping services as well as the UPS Store, a retail chain which assists UPS shipments and provides tools for small businesses. UPS offers air shipping on an overnight or two-day basis and delivers to post office boxes through UPS Mail Innovations and UPS Ground Saver.

about: GXO Logistics is a US contract logistics company headquartered in Greenwich, Connecticut and listed on the NYSE (GXO), spun off from XPO in 2021. It runs warehouses and fulfilment for retailers, e-commerce, consumer goods and healthcare clients, with over 1,000 sites, around 150,000 employees and revenue near 11 billion dollars, notably in the UK after acquiring Wincanton in 2024. Founded as part of XPO. B2B logistics brand with limited consumer awareness.

wiki.title: GXO Logistics
wiki.what: American contract logistics and warehousing company
wiki.text: GXO Logistics, Inc. is an American multinational contract logistics company that manages outsourced supply chains and warehousing, and reverse logistics in over thirty countries. GXO's corporate headquarters are located in Greenwich, Connecticut, U.S.

about: J.B. Hunt Transport Services is a US transportation and logistics company headquartered in Lowell, Arkansas and listed on Nasdaq (JBHT). It runs intermodal container services with railroads, dedicated contract trucking, truckload, final-mile delivery and brokerage, with fleets of containers and tractors, serving retailers, manufacturers and shippers, with revenue near 12 billion dollars. Founded 1961. B2B logistics brand with limited consumer awareness.

Phillips 66 is a US energy manufacturing and logistics company headquartered in Houston, Texas and listed on the NYSE (PSX), spun out of ConocoPhillips in 2012. It operates refineries, midstream pipelines through Phillips 66 Partners, chemicals (CPChem joint venture) and marketing, with brands Phillips 66, Conoco and 76 sold at thousands of US fuel stations. Revenue is around 140 billion dollars. Customers are drivers and industrial buyers. Strong fuel retail brand and long motorsport sponsorship tradition.

wiki.title: Phillips 66
wiki.text: The Phillips 66 Company is an American multinational energy company headquartered in Westchase, Houston, Texas. Its name, dating back to 1927 as a trademark of the Phillips Petroleum Company, assisted in establishing the newly reconfigured Phillips 66. The company today was formed ten years after Phillips merged with Conoco to form ConocoPhillips. The merged company spun off its refining, chemical, and retail assets – known in the oil industry as downstream operations – into a new company bearing the Phillips 66 name. It began trading on the New York Stock Exchange on May 1, 2012, under the ticker PSX.

about: Wabtec (Westinghouse Air Brake Technologies) is a US rail technology company headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania and listed on the NYSE (WAB). It makes locomotives (after acquiring GE Transportation in 2019), braking and signalling systems, and digital rail technology, serving freight railroads, transit agencies and mining, with around 29,000 employees and revenue over 10 billion dollars. Founded 1869. B2B industrial brand with limited consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Wabtec
wiki.text: Westinghouse Air Brake Technologies Corporation, commonly known as Wabtec, is an American rail equipment company formed by the merger of the Westinghouse Air Brake Company (WABCO) and MotivePower in 1999. It is headquartered in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania.

about: Scan Global Logistics is a Danish international freight forwarding and logistics group offering air, sea and road freight, contract logistics and project cargo through a network of offices in dozens of countries, expanded by many acquisitions. Based in Hvidovre near Copenhagen, with revenue of several billion euros. Customers are importers and exporters. Privately held, backed by private equity. B2B, with limited consumer brand awareness.

Tristar Transport, part of Tristar Group, is a Dubai-based logistics company specialising in the transport and storage of bulk liquids such as fuel, chemicals and lubricants by road, sea and terminals across the Middle East, Africa and Asia. Customers are oil and gas, chemicals and industrial firms, with revenue from transport, storage and fuel services. Crunchbase shows about $1.1 billion in funding, likely debt and investment. Privately held. B2B, little consumer awareness.

Sydney-based supply-chain logistics group, founded 1875, best known for the blue CHEP pallets and reusable crates which it rents to manufacturers and retailers in about 60 countries. Revenue is around AUD 7 billion with around 12,000 staff. Listed on the ASX (BXB). B2B brand with no consumer profile, although its pallets move a large share of global consumer goods. Brambles employs about 12,000 people and operates a pool of over 350 million pallets and crates, mainly for supermarkets and food suppliers.

wiki.title: Rubus
wiki.what: Genus of plants in the rose family
wiki.text: Rubus is a large and diverse genus of flowering plants in the rose family, Rosaceae, subfamily Rosoideae, most commonly known as brambles. Fruits of various species are known as raspberries, blackberries, dewberries, cloudberries, and bristleberries. It is a diverse genus, and estimates of the number of Rubus species vary from 250 to over 1,000, found across all continents except Antarctica.

wiki.title: Brambles Limited
wiki.text: Brambles Limited is an Australian company that specialises in the pooling of unit-load equipment, pallets, crates and containers. It is listed on the Australian Securities Exchange.

about: San Francisco-based freight forwarding and logistics platform, founded 2013, moving goods by air, ocean and truck for importers and exporters. Customers are shippers. Raised about $2.7 billion and was valued at $8 billion. B2B logistics brand. Offices are in the US, Europe and Asia, and the business sells through account managers and a digital platform. Brand awareness limited outside logistics buyers.

wiki.title: Flexport
wiki.what: American supply chain management and logistics company
wiki.text: Flexport Inc. is an American multinational corporation that focuses on supply chain management and logistics, including order management, delivery, trade financing, insurance, freight forwarding, and customs brokerage. The company is headquartered in San Francisco, California,

about: inDrive is a mobility and urban services platform, founded in Russia as Indriver, with registered offices in Mountain View, California, which lets riders negotiate fares with drivers. It also offers delivery, freight, financial and other services in about 45 countries across Latin America, Asia and Africa. It has raised about $537 million. Strong consumer brand in emerging markets and active in sports sponsorship.

wiki.title: InDrive
wiki.text: inDrive is a US-headquartered mobility and delivery platform operating in over 1,200 cities across 48 countries. In addition to ride-hailing, inDrive offers intercity transportation, delivery, courier, financial and advertising services.

about: Kuehne + Nagel is a Swiss global logistics group headquartered in Schindellegi, offering sea logistics, air logistics, road logistics and contract logistics in over 100 countries, with about 80,000 employees and revenue of roughly 25 billion Swiss francs. Customers are exporters, importers and manufacturers. Founded in 1890 in Bremen, it is listed on SIX Swiss Exchange (KNIN) and controlled by Klaus-Michael Kuehne. B2B with visible sponsorship in sport, including Hamburg football, and a track record with Formula 1-adjacent logistics.

wiki.title: Kuehne + Nagel
wiki.what: Global transport and logistics company based in Switzerland
wiki.text: Kuehne + Nagel International AG is a global transport and logistics company based in Schindellegi, Switzerland. Its main owner and operator was Klaus-Michael Kühne via his Kühne Holding and Kühne Foundation. The company was founded in 1890 in Bremen, Germany. It provides sea freight and airfreight forwarding, contract logistics, and overland businesses. As of 2023, it has nearly 1,300 offices in over 100 countries and nearly 79,000 employees.

about: MTN Group is a Johannesburg-based mobile telecommunications operator, one of Africa's largest, serving about 280 million subscribers in around 20 markets across Africa and the Middle East, including Nigeria, South Africa, Ghana and Uganda. It earns from voice, data, fintech through MoMo mobile money, and enterprise services. Listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange (MTN). It is a major consumer brand in Africa and has sponsored football and music.

wiki.title: MTN Group
wiki.what: Multinational telecommunications company based in South Africa ayomide
wiki.text: MTN Group Limited is a South African multinational corporation and mobile telecommunications provider. Its head office is in Johannesburg. MTN is among the largest mobile network operators in the world, and the largest in Africa.

about: SF Express is China's largest courier, headquartered in Shenzhen but shown here with a Singapore listing address for its international arm. It offers express parcels, freight, cold chain, supply chain and international logistics, with its own aircraft fleet and the Hubei Ezhou hub. Revenue is over 280 billion yuan. Founded in 1993, it is listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange (002352), led by Wang Wei. Well-known consumer delivery brand in China, with the SF Holding group expanding abroad.
cb_desc: SF Express is a third-party distribution platform which...

wiki.title: SF Express
wiki.text: SF Express (Group) Co., Ltd. is a Chinese multinational delivery services and logistics company based in Shenzhen, Guangdong. It is the largest courier in China, and provides domestic and international express delivery. SF Express operates a fleet of cargo aircraft, which are owned by its subsidiary SF Airlines. The parent company of SF Express, SF Holding trades on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange and the Hong Kong Stock Exchange. It is a constituent of SZSE 100 Index.

about: ID Logistics Group is a French contract logistics company based in Cavaillon, offering warehousing, order preparation, transport management and e-commerce fulfilment for retail, consumer goods, industry and health clients in about 20 countries. It operates around 400 sites, with revenue of about 3 billion euros. Founded in 2000 by Eric Hemar, it is listed on Euronext Paris (IDL). B2B logistics brand with limited consumer awareness.

Hyundai Glovis is the logistics arm of the Hyundai Motor Group, headquartered in Seoul, South Korea. It runs car-carrier shipping fleets, finished vehicle logistics, contract logistics, bulk shipping and Hyundai group parts distribution across several continents. Customers are mainly Hyundai, Kia and affiliates plus third-party shippers, with revenue above US$15 billion. It is listed on the Korea Exchange (086280), with Chung Eui-sun the controlling shareholder. B2B shipping brand with low consumer awareness, though known inside the automotive supply chain.

wiki.title: Hyundai Glovis
wiki.text: Hyundai Glovis Co., Ltd. is a logistics company headquartered in Seoul, South Korea and part of the Hyundai Motor Group. Its predecessor company, Hankook Logitech Co. Ltd was formed in February 2001. Hyundai Glovis supplies ocean transportation logistics advice, cargo space, loading/unloading, and packaging services. It changed its name to Hyundai Glovis in June 2003.

about: Thor Industries is the world's largest recreational vehicle maker, based in Elkhart, Indiana, with brands such as Airstream, Jayco, Thor Motor Coach, Keystone, Heartland, Dutchmen and, in Europe, Erwin Hymer Group (Hymer, Eriba, Dethleffs). It sells through dealer networks to leisure and outdoor consumers, with annual revenue around US$10 billion. It is listed on the NYSE (THO). The Airstream and Jayco names have strong consumer recognition in North America and Europe, though the parent is less known.

wiki.title: Thor Industries
wiki.text: Thor Industries, Inc. is an American manufacturer of recreational vehicles (RVs). The company sells towable and motorized RVs through its subsidiaries brands including Airstream, Heartland RV, Jayco, and others. The company's headquarters is in Elkhart, Indiana. It has manufacturing facilities in Michigan, Ohio, Indiana, Idaho and Oregon.

about: Corning is a materials science company in Corning, New York, founded 1851, making specialty glass (Gorilla Glass for smartphones), optical fiber and cable, ceramics and life science labware, supplying Apple, Samsung, telecom carriers and data center customers. Revenue is around $13-14 billion. Listed on the NYSE (GLW). Known for Gorilla Glass and Pyrex heritage, B2B largely, with decent technology brand awareness.

James Hardie Industries is an Irish-domiciled fibre cement maker, with North American operations in Chicago, selling HardiePlank siding, trim, backer board and decking to homebuilders, contractors and homeowners in the US, Australia, New Zealand and Europe. It acquired Azek in 2025 for about 8.75 billion dollars. It is listed on the NYSE (JHX) and ASX. It is a well known building products brand in the US among builders and renovators, and its marketing is aimed at homeowners.

wiki.title: James Hardie Industries
wiki.text: James Hardie Industries plc is an American-Irish global building materials company and the largest global manufacturer of fibre cement products. Headquartered in Ireland, it is cross-listed on the Australian and New York Stock Exchanges. Its management team currently sits in Chicago, Illinois, United States. James Hardie was plagued by several asbestos-related scandals in the 20th century.

about: Sika is a Swiss specialty chemicals company founded in 1910 in Baar, Zug, that makes construction chemicals and industrial products: sealants, adhesives, waterproofing, concrete admixtures, roofing and automotive bonding materials. Customers are builders, contractors and car and industrial manufacturers in more than 100 countries, with sales above CHF 11 billion and around 34,000 employees. Listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange (SIKA). Strong B2B brand, with consumer exposure through DIY stores and motorsport partnerships.

Swedish engineering group in Stockholm, listed on Nasdaq Stockholm (SAND), producing mining equipment, rock tools and metal-cutting tools (Sandvik Coromant). Founded in 1862, it has divisions for mining and rock solutions, rock processing and manufacturing and machining solutions, and spun off its materials business as Alleima in 2022. About 40,000 employees. Revenue about SEK 120 billion. Strong B2B brand.

wiki.title: Sandvik
wiki.text: Sandvik AB is a Swedish multinational engineering company specializing in products and services for mining, rock excavation, rock drilling, rock processing, metal cutting and machining. The company was founded in Gävleborg County, Sweden, in 1862. In 2024, it had approximately 41,000 employees and a revenue of 123 billion SEK, with sales in around 150 countries.

about: Madrid-based online staffing marketplace, Jobandtalent, founded 2009, matching temporary and flexible workers with employers across Europe and the US. Raised about $1.7 billion and was valued at $2.5 billion. B2B and worker-facing brand. Its main customers include logistics, retail and construction firms. Jobandtalent says it works with tens of thousands of companies, and its platform assigns workers on short-term or permanent contracts.

US cell tower real estate investment trust from Boston, owning about 150,000 communication sites worldwide, leased to mobile operators. Listed on the NYSE (AMT). The company was founded in 1995, owns data centres through CoreSite (bought in 2021), and counts AT&T, T-Mobile and Verizon as tenants. It also operates in India, Africa, Europe and Latin America. B2B infrastructure owner with no consumer brand.

wiki.title: American Tower
wiki.text: American Tower Corporation is an American real estate investment trust which owns, develops and operates wireless and broadcast communications infrastructure in several countries. It is headquartered in Boston, Massachusetts.

about: DayOne is a Singapore-headquartered developer and operator of hyperscale data centers and AI infrastructure, serving cloud providers and large internet companies with leased capacity across Asia, with campuses in markets such as Malaysia (Johor), Indonesia, Thailand and China. Originally spun out of China's GDS International. It has raised about $14.5 billion in total funding, latest in October 2026. B2B infrastructure with little consumer brand awareness.
cb_desc: DayOne develops and operates hyperscale digital...

about: Nscale is a London-based AI infrastructure company building AI data centers and operating GPU cloud services for AI developers and enterprises, with sites in Norway (Glomfjord), the UK and elsewhere, and partnerships with Nvidia and Microsoft. Spun out of Arkon Energy. Crunchbase shows about $13.3 billion in total funding, latest in September 2026. B2B infrastructure provider, young and fast-growing, with little consumer brand awareness.
cb_desc: Nscale builds Al data centers and provides GPU cloud...

wiki.title: Nscale
wiki.text: Nscale is a British technology company that operates data centres and GPU cloud infrastructure. Headquartered in London, Nscale was founded in 2024 by Josh Payne. It operates across the US, Europe, and in Asia.

about: NVIDIA designs GPUs, AI accelerators, networking and software platforms (CUDA, DGX, GeForce, Blackwell chips) that dominate AI training and data center computing, with further business in gaming, professional graphics and automotive. Customers include hyperscalers, enterprises, PC makers and gamers; revenue is chip and system sales. Headquartered in Santa Clara, California, founded 1993, listed on Nasdaq (NVDA) and among the world's most valuable companies. Strong consumer brand via GeForce gaming and a frequent sponsor and partner of tech and sport.

wiki.title: Nvidia
wiki.text: Nvidia Corporation is an American multinational technology company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. The company develops graphics processing units (GPUs), systems on chips (SoCs), and application programming interfaces (APIs) for gaming, data science, high-performance computing, artificial intelligence (AI) hardware, and mobile and automotive applications. Founded in 1993 by Jensen Huang, Chris Malachowsky, and Curtis Priem, Nvidia is among the largest companies by market capitalization.

about: Abu Dhabi Ports Company, now operating as AD Ports Group, develops and runs ports, industrial zones, logistics, maritime services and digital trade platforms, including Khalifa Port and KEZAD. Customers are shipping lines, manufacturers and traders. Majority owned by the Abu Dhabi government through ADQ and listed on the Abu Dhabi Securities Exchange (ADPORTS). Growing international presence in Africa, Asia and Europe. B2B and state-linked; active in sports and event sponsorship in the Gulf.

wiki.title: AD Ports Group
wiki.what: UAE ports, industrial zones, and logistics operator
wiki.text: AD Ports Group is the exclusive developer and regulator of ports and related infrastructure in Abu Dhabi.

about: ACS (Actividades de Construccion y Servicios) is a Spanish construction and infrastructure group headquartered in Madrid, controlled by Florentino Perez, who is also president of Real Madrid. It owns Hochtief in Germany (with Turner and CIMIC), and Vias, and develops transport, energy and data center projects. Customers are governments and corporates; revenue is around 40 billion euros. Listed on the Madrid stock exchange (ACS). B2B, with limited consumer visibility.

Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone is India's largest private port operator, running Mundra and a network of ports and terminals plus logistics, rail and marine services, and some international terminals such as Haifa and Colombo. Customers are shipping lines, cargo owners and industrial groups. Part of the Adani Group, headquartered in Ahmedabad, and listed in India (NSE and BSE: ADANIPORTS). B2B infrastructure with strong brand recognition in India.

wiki.title: Adani Ports & SEZ
wiki.what: Indian multinational port operator and logistics company pvt ltd
wiki.text: Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone Limited (APSEZ) is an Indian multinational port operator and logistics company, part of Adani Group. It is India's largest private port operator with a network of 12 ports and terminals, including India's first port-based SEZ at Mundra and the first deep water transshipment port at Thiruvananthapuram. The company has attracted controversies for cronyism, alleged stock manipulation and violation of environmental norms.

about: Celestica is a Toronto-based electronics manufacturing services company that designs, manufactures and supplies hardware for communications, cloud and AI data center customers (including hyperscalers), as well as aerospace and industrial clients, with plants in Asia, Mexico and Europe. Revenue passed $9 billion in 2024 driven by AI networking and servers. Listed on the NYSE and Toronto Stock Exchange (CLS). B2B contract manufacturer with little consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Celestica
wiki.text: Celestica Inc. is a Canadian multinational design, manufacturing, hardware platform, and supply chain electronics manufacturing services (EMS) company, which is headquartered in Toronto, Ontario. The company operates in 50 sites across 15 countries.

about: Cerebras Systems is a Sunnyvale, California AI chip and systems company, founded in 2016, known for its Wafer-Scale Engine, a very large processor, and the CS-series systems. It sells AI hardware and cloud inference services to enterprises, research labs, governments and sovereign AI customers, with partners such as G42. Crunchbase shows about $4.7 billion in total funding. Went through a long IPO process. B2B, with limited consumer brand awareness.

wiki.title: Cerebras Systems
wiki.text: Cerebras Systems Inc., headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, develops semiconductors, supercomputers, and related software to power artificial intelligence deep-learning applications such as inference engines. Products include its wafer scale engine (WSE)-3 semiconductors, its CS-3 supercomputers, and its "AI inference cloud" and "AI training cloud" APIs, which allow users to access the company's computing power without buying its hardware. The company also builds data centers using its processors and supercomputers to provide cloud computing services directly to clients.

about: Cloudflare is a San Francisco-based web infrastructure and security company founded in 2009, providing a global network offering CDN, DDoS protection, zero trust security, DNS, serverless edge computing (Workers) and AI inference to millions of internet properties and enterprises. Revenue is above $1.5 billion from subscriptions. Listed on the NYSE (NET). B2B but well known in tech; it has previously sponsored sports, including a Formula 1 team technology partnership.

wiki.title: Cloudflare
wiki.text: Cloudflare, Inc., is an American technology company headquartered in San Francisco, California, that provides a range of internet services, including content delivery network (CDN) services, cloud cybersecurity, DDoS mitigation, and ICANN-accredited domain registration. The company's services act primarily as a reverse proxy between website visitors and a customer's hosting provider, improving performance and protecting against malicious traffic.

about: Crusoe is a Denver, Colorado AI infrastructure company that builds energy-aware AI data centers and offers GPU cloud services, originally focused on using stranded or flared natural gas for compute and now building large campuses such as Abilene, Texas for OpenAI and Oracle (Stargate). Customers are AI labs and enterprises. Crunchbase shows about $8.1 billion in total funding. Private, B2B, with growing profile in AI circles but low consumer awareness.

Envision Group is a Shanghai-based energy technology company founded by Zhang Lei in 2007, with Envision Energy (wind turbines), Envision AESC (batteries, with Nissan as a customer), and green hydrogen and energy storage businesses, plus an AIoT platform. Customers include utilities, automakers and developers. Privately held. Envision has also been a title sponsor of the Envision Racing Formula E team. B2B, but with real exposure in motorsport.

Equinix is a Redwood City, California digital infrastructure company operating over 250 International Business Exchange data centers across about 70 metros on six continents, offering colocation, interconnection and the Platform Equinix, serving cloud providers, networks and enterprises. Revenue is around $8.5 billion. Listed on Nasdaq (EQIX) and structured as a REIT. B2B brand, recognised in technology circles but limited consumer awareness.

wiki.title: Equinix
wiki.what: American internet and data center company
wiki.text: Equinix Inc., is an American multinational internet and data center company headquartered in Redwood City, California. It specialized in internet connectivity and data center colocation centers, commonly known as carrier hotels, until the company converted to a real estate investment trust (REIT) in January 2015. It is listed on the Nasdaq stock exchange under the ticker symbol EQIX. As of 2025, the company operates 260 data centers in 33 countries, across five continents and employed more than 13,000 people worldwide.

about: Shapoorji Pallonji Group is a Mumbai-headquartered Indian conglomerate, over 150 years old, with businesses in construction and engineering (Shapoorji Pallonji & Co.), real estate, infrastructure, water, energy, shipping, textiles, and finance, plus a major stake in Tata Sons (about 18%). It is controlled by the Mistry family. Customers are governments, corporates and home buyers. Privately held. Well known in India's business and construction sector, but mostly B2B.

wiki.title: Shapoorji Pallonji Group
wiki.text: Shapoorji Pallonji & Company Private Limited (SPCPL), trading as Shapoorji Pallonji Group, is an Indian conglomerate headquartered in Mumbai. Its primary business interests include construction and engineering, infrastructure, real estate, energy, and textiles, among others. The company was headed by a grandson of founder Pallonji Mistry, also named Pallonji Mistry, until 2012, when he announced his retirement and the succession of his son, Shapoor Mistry.

about: Snowflake is a San Mateo, California cloud data platform founded in 2012 that lets enterprises store, analyse and share data and build AI applications across AWS, Azure and Google Cloud, sold on consumption pricing to thousands of customers including many Fortune 500 firms. Revenue exceeds $3.5 billion. Listed on the NYSE (SNOW) after a 2020 IPO. B2B tech brand, known among data teams; also an active sports sponsor, including with Formula 1 teams.

wiki.title: Snowflake
wiki.what: Ice crystals that fall as snow
wiki.text: A snowflake is a single ice crystal that is large enough to fall through the Earth's atmosphere as snow. Snow appears white in color despite being made of clear ice. This is because the many small crystal facets of the snowflakes scatter the sunlight between them.

about: The Boring Company is an Elon Musk-founded tunneling company based in Bastrop, Texas, building underground transport tunnels, including the Las Vegas Convention Center Loop that carries passengers in Tesla vehicles, plus other loop proposals. Customers are city and venue authorities, with revenue from construction contracts and rides. Spun out of SpaceX in 2016. Crunchbase shows funding of about $3.9 billion in total. Privately held, with strong media visibility via Musk.

wiki.title: The Boring Company
wiki.text: The Boring Company (TBC) is an American infrastructure, tunnel construction service, and equipment company founded by Elon Musk. TBC was founded as a subsidiary of SpaceX in 2017, and was spun off as a separate corporation in 2018. The original Las Vegas Convention Center Loop opened in 2021. By late 2026 the Vegas Loop had expanded to roughly 14 operational stations and had carried more than 4 million passengers. Clark County has approved up to 68 miles and more than 100 stations. A roughly two-mile Paradise Road twin-tunnel section was expected to open before the November 2026 Formula 1 race. The company has tested self-driving operation wi

about: WSP Global is a Montreal-headquartered engineering and professional services firm (Quebec, despite the Ontario label in the data), providing design, advisory and project management for transportation, buildings, water, power, energy and environment in about 50 countries with over 70,000 employees. Revenue is around C$15 billion, and it acquired Golder, Wood's environment unit and others. Listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange (WSP). B2B, little consumer awareness.

wiki.title: WSP Global
wiki.text: WSP is a Canadian engineering and professional services consulting firm providing technical and advisory services across the full lifecycle of built and natural environment projects. The company is listed on the Toronto Stock Exchange and is part of the S&P/TSX 60 and S&P/TSX Composite indices, with annual revenues exceeding C$16 billion in 2024.

about: Caterpillar is the world's largest maker of construction and mining equipment, producing bulldozers, excavators, loaders, trucks, engines, turbines and rail products under the Cat brand, as well as financial services through Cat Financial. It was founded in 1925 and is listed on the NYSE (CAT), with revenue of about 65 billion dollars and over 110,000 employees. It moved headquarters from Peoria, Illinois to Irving, Texas. Cat is a hugely recognised industrial brand, with a yellow-and-black identity visible in consumer merchandise.

wiki.title: Caterpillar
wiki.what: Larva of a butterfly or moth
wiki.text: Caterpillars are the larval stage of members of the order Lepidoptera. In common speech, any caterpillar-shaped insect larva such as of a sawfly is often called a caterpillar.

wiki.title: Caterpillar Inc.
wiki.text: Caterpillar Inc. is an American manufacturer of construction, mining, and other engineering equipment. The company is the world's largest manufacturer of construction equipment. In 2025, Caterpillar was ranked 64th on the Fortune 500 and 118th on the Forbes Global 2000. Caterpillar stock is a component of the Dow Jones Industrial Average.

about: ACCIONA is a Spanish infrastructure and renewable energy group headquartered in Madrid, founded in 1997 from the merger of Entrecanales y Tavora and Cubiertas. Its businesses include renewable power generation (wind, solar, hydro), construction and engineering, water treatment and desalination, and services, with operations in more than 20 countries and revenue of roughly EUR 18 billion. Customers are utilities, governments and corporates. Listed on the Madrid exchange (ANA); Entrecanales family is the controlling shareholder. It owns the Spanish ACCIONA Energia, and has sponsored the Spanish sailing and Formula E world.

Baseten is a San Francisco AI infrastructure startup, founded in 2019, that provides an inference platform for deploying and serving machine learning models in production for developers and enterprises. Revenue comes from usage-based compute and platform fees. Customers include AI-native startups and larger companies running generative AI models. It has raised large venture rounds from investors such as IVP, Spark and Greylock, with total funding of about $2.1 billion per Crunchbase. B2B developer brand with little public awareness.

Fluidstack is a cloud provider of GPU compute for AI labs and enterprises, building and operating large AI data-centre clusters for customers such as Anthropic and Mistral AI. Founded in London in 2017 and now based in New York per Crunchbase, it has raised about $2.4 billion in funding. Revenue is from compute capacity contracts. B2B infrastructure, low consumer awareness.
cb_desc: Fluidstack provides cloud infrastructure for Al with GPU...

about: Huawei is the Chinese telecoms and technology giant founded in 1987 by Ren Zhengfei and based in Shenzhen. It makes mobile networks equipment, smartphones, laptops, wearables, cloud and AI services, Ascend AI chips, HarmonyOS and increasingly smart-car solutions, with revenue above 700 billion yuan and around 200,000 staff in 170 countries. Employee-owned and unlisted. Customers are carriers, enterprises, governments and consumers. Very high consumer brand awareness; US restrictions limit some markets.

wiki.title: Huawei
wiki.text: Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd. is a Chinese multinational technology conglomerate company headquartered in Longgang, Shenzhen, Guangdong. Its main product lines include telecommunications equipment, consumer electronics, electric vehicle autonomous driving systems, and rooftop solar power products. The company was founded in Shenzhen in 1987 by Ren Zhengfei, a veteran officer of the People's Liberation Army (PLA).

about: Nutanix is a US hybrid multicloud software company that sells hyperconverged infrastructure and a cloud platform that runs virtual machines and applications across data centres and public clouds. Customers are large enterprises, governments and service providers, with revenue from subscriptions of about $2.5 billion a year. Founded in 2009, based in San Jose, California, and listed on Nasdaq (NTNX). B2B tech brand, benefitting from customers leaving VMware.

wiki.title: Nutanix
wiki.what: American enterprise virtualization and storage company
wiki.text: Nutanix, Inc. is an American cloud computing company that develops software for datacenters and hybrid multi-cloud deployments. It is based in San Jose, California.

about: SambaNova is a US AI hardware and software company, founded in 2017 in Palo Alto and based in San Jose, California, that sells reconfigurable dataflow chips (SN40L) and a full-stack platform and cloud service for running large AI models, with a focus on fast inference. Customers are enterprises, governments and national labs. It has raised about $1.1 billion from SoftBank, Intel Capital and others, with total shown near $2.5 billion. B2B with limited public awareness.

wiki.title: SambaNova
wiki.text: SambaNova is an American artificial intelligence (AI) and semiconductor hardware company. The company designs and manufactures hardware accelerators termed Reconfigurable Dataflow Units (RDUs) adjusted for deep learning models and generative AI applications.

about: Stora Enso is a Helsinki forest products group producing packaging board, biomaterials, wooden building products (CLT) and paper, with some 20,000 staff and operations in Europe, China and the Americas. Revenue is about 9 billion euros. It is listed in Helsinki and Stockholm (STERV, STE). The company is B2B, selling to packaging and publishing customers, with limited consumer brand awareness.

wiki.title: Stora Enso
wiki.what: Finnish and Swedish pulp and paper company
wiki.text: Stora Enso Oyj is a Finnish and Swedish forest industry company. It develops and produces various materials, mostly based on wood, for a range of industries and applications worldwide.

about: HUMAIN is a Saudi Arabian artificial intelligence company launched in 2025 and owned by the Public Investment Fund. It builds data centres, AI models such as the ALLaM Arabic model, cloud services and AI applications, working with Nvidia, AMD, AWS and others. Customers are Saudi government and enterprises. It is chaired by Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman. A very new brand with strong state backing and high ambition.

Modal Labs is a New York startup offering a serverless cloud platform to run AI and data workloads, letting developers run code on GPUs without managing infrastructure. Customers are AI companies and developers paying for usage. Founded in 2021 by Erik Bernhardsson, it has raised over 100 million dollars in venture funding. A B2B developer brand with limited public awareness.
cb_desc: Modal Labs is a serverless cloud infrastructure platform...

about: Together AI is a San Francisco AI cloud company that lets developers run, fine-tune and train open-source AI models on GPU clusters through an API. Customers are AI startups and enterprises paying for compute and inference. Founded in 2022, it has raised over 500 million dollars, including a 2025 round at a multi-billion dollar valuation. A B2B developer brand. Customers are paying users of its GPUs and models, and it is among the fast-growing AI infrastructure startups. Its brand is known to developers, not consumers.

VINCI is a Nanterre, France concessions and construction group, one of the world's largest, operating motorways (Cofiroute, ASF), airports (including Lyon, Lisbon, Gatwick and Kansai) and building via Eurovia and VINCI Construction. Revenue is above 70 billion euros with over 270,000 staff. Listed on Euronext Paris (DG). A well-known European infrastructure brand with sport sponsorships in France. Customers are governments and companies as well as motorists, who pay tolls. VINCI is a major European infrastructure brand with sponsorships in sport and culture, and it is listed in Paris.

wiki.title: Vinci SA
wiki.text: Vinci is a French concessions and construction company founded in 1899 as Société Générale d'Entreprises. Its head office is in Nanterre, in the western suburbs of Paris. Vinci is listed on Euronext's Paris stock exchange and is a member of the Euro Stoxx 50 index.

about: Dallas-based engineering and infrastructure consulting firm, listed on the NYSE (ACM), providing design, program management and construction services for governments and corporations in transportation, water and energy. Formed in 1990, it works worldwide, with a large share of revenue from US public agencies. Revenue about 16 billion dollars with around 50,000 employees. B2B brand.

wiki.title: AECOM
wiki.text: AECOM is an American multinational infrastructure consulting firm headquartered in Dallas, Texas.

about: DriveNets is a Ra'anana, Israel-based software networking company whose Network Cloud approach uses white box hardware to build large routers for telecom operators, and now AI networking via Network Cloud-AI. Customers include AT&T and Comcast. Raised about $1.6 billion in funding. B2B technology with little consumer awareness.

wiki.title: DriveNets
wiki.text: DriveNets is an Israeli networking software company headquartered in Ra'anana. It develops network infrastructure software for organizations building AI systems, including AI labs, cloud providers and enterprises, and for telecommunications service providers. Its two product lines are AI Fabric, an Ethernet-based networking product for AI clusters, and Network Cloud, a network operating system that runs on white-box hardware and on DriveNets' networking hardware.

about: UK engineering AI company founded in 2019, building machine learning models that simulate physics for design and manufacturing in aerospace, automotive, energy and semiconductors. Co-founded by Jacomo Corbo and Robin Tuluie, who is a former Formula 1 engineer. Customers are engineering and manufacturing companies buying software and services. Based in London, backed by investors such as Atomico and Siemens, with total funding of about $487 million. Notable F1-adjacent engineering background but a B2B brand.

US managed cloud services company that helps enterprises run applications across AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud and private clouds, with consulting and managed security. Based in San Antonio, Texas; taken private by Apollo Global Management in 2016 and returned to Nasdaq (RXT) in 2020. Revenue about $2.7 billion, thousands of employees and a heavy debt load. Customers are mid-size and large organisations worldwide. Funding shown of about $543 million. Known in IT, not to consumers.

wiki.title: Rackspace Technology
wiki.text: Rackspace Technology, Inc. is an American information technology cloud computing company based in San Antonio, Texas. It also has offices in Reston, Virginia, as well as in Australia, Canada, United Kingdom, India, Dubai, Switzerland, the Netherlands, Germany, Singapore, Mexico, Toronto and Hong Kong. Its data centers are located in Amsterdam (Netherlands), Virginia (US), Chicago (US), Dallas (US), London (UK), Frankfurt (Germany), Hong Kong (China), Kansas City (US), New York City (US), San Jose (US), Shanghai (China), Queenstown (Singapore) and Sydney (Australia).

about: ThyssenKrupp is a German industrial group, headquartered in Essen, with businesses in steel (Thyssenkrupp Steel Europe), materials services, automotive technology, marine systems (submarines, frigates) and a stake in elevators sold in 2020 to private equity. Customers are carmakers, construction, machinery and navies. It has around 100,000 employees and revenue of tens of billions of euros. Listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange (TKA). Crunchbase shows about 1.4 billion in funding, dated 2018. B2B industrial brand with strong recognition in Germany, and a sponsor of sport and the arts.

wiki.title: ThyssenKrupp
wiki.text: ThyssenKrupp AG is a German industrial engineering and steel production company. It resulted from the 1999 merger of Thyssen AG and Krupp and has its operational headquarters in Duisburg and Essen. The company says that it is one of the largest steel producers in the world, and it was ranked tenth-largest worldwide by revenue in 2015. It is divided into 670 subsidiaries worldwide. The largest shareholders are the Alfried Krupp von Bohlen und Halbach Foundation and Cevian Capital. ThyssenKrupp's products range from machines and industrial services to high-speed trains, elevators, and shipbuilding. The subsidiary ThyssenKrupp Marine Systems als

about: Fincantieri is an Italian shipbuilding group based in Trieste, one of the world's biggest, building cruise ships, naval vessels, offshore and specialist ships, with shipyards in Italy and the US, and providing ship systems and services. Customers include Carnival, MSC, Viking and other cruise lines, as well as the Italian navy and foreign navies. About 70 percent is controlled by the Italian state through Cassa Depositi e Prestiti, and it is listed on Borsa Italiana as FCT. Annual revenue is several billion euros. A B2B industrial brand, known in maritime circles.

wiki.title: Fincantieri
wiki.text: Fincantieri S.p.A. is an Italian shipbuilding company based in Trieste, Italy. It is the only operator active in every segment of high-tech shipbuilding: from cruise to naval ships, as well as offshore units and underwater solutions.

about: Epiroc is a Swedish mining and infrastructure equipment company, spun off from Atlas Copco in 2018, that makes rock drilling rigs, underground loaders and trucks, mining and construction tools, and also software, automation and aftermarket services. Customers are mining companies and construction contractors worldwide, with a large share of revenue from service and parts. Headquartered in Nacka near Stockholm, it has roughly 18,000 employees and revenue of about 60 billion Swedish kronor. Listed on Nasdaq Stockholm (EPI A and EPI B). B2B industrial brand, well known in mining, but not to consumers.

wiki.title: Epiroc
wiki.text: Epiroc AB is a Swedish manufacturer of mining and infrastructure equipment. It is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden and has its manufacturing facilities in Sweden, the United States, Canada, Australia, China, India, Japan, and Germany.

about: Dubai real estate developer DarGlobal, a unit of Dar Al Arkan, developing luxury branded residences such as Trump International projects in Jeddah, Dubai and the Maldives. Listed on London AIM. Customers are wealthy property buyers. The parent, Dar Al Arkan, is a Saudi Arabian developer listed on Tadawul, and DarGlobal markets its branded projects internationally under licences such as Trump and Versace. Brand moderately visible in luxury property.

wiki.title: DarGlobal
wiki.text: Dar Global PLC is a real estate development company headquartered in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and is publicly listed on the London Stock Exchange (LSE). The company began trading on the LSE on February 28, 2023, becoming the first Saudi company to be listed on the main market of the London Stock Exchange.

about: Digital Realty is a data center REIT that leases colocation, interconnection and hyperscale space to cloud providers, enterprises and network operators, with several hundred facilities across about 25 countries and key platforms such as PlatformDIGITAL and Interxion. Revenue comes from long-term leases. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, and listed on the NYSE (DLR), with a market value well above $50 billion. B2B infrastructure brand, little consumer awareness, but active in corporate sponsorship at times.

wiki.title: Digital Realty
wiki.text: Digital Realty is an American real estate investment trust that owns, operates, and invests in carrier-neutral data centers across the world. The company offers data center, colocation, and interconnection services. It was formed in 2004 by GI Partners. As of June 2023, Digital Realty has over 300 facilities in more than 25 countries.

about: Avis Budget Group is a Parsippany, New Jersey car rental group operating the Avis, Budget and Zipcar brands, plus Payless, Apex and others, serving leisure and business travellers at airports and city locations in about 180 countries via company-owned and licensee operations. Revenue comes from rentals and ancillary services, fleet around 700,000 vehicles. Listed on Nasdaq (CAR). Strong consumer brands, with past sports sponsorship experience.

wiki.title: Avis Budget Group
wiki.what: Holding company of several car rental brands
wiki.text: Avis Budget Group, Inc. is an American car rental agency holding company headquartered in Parsippany, New Jersey. It is one of the three big rental car holding companies in the United States. In 2021, it held a 26% market share, placing it behind both the Hertz Global Holdings and Enterprise Holdings. It is the parent company of several brands including Avis Car Rental, Budget Rent a Car, Budget Truck Rental, Payless Car Rental, and Zipcar.

about: Blackstone is the world's largest alternative asset manager, based in New York, with over $1 trillion in assets under management across private equity, real estate, credit and hedge fund solutions, serving pensions, sovereign wealth funds and individuals. Revenue comes from management and performance fees. Founded 1985 by Stephen Schwarzman and Peter Peterson, listed on the NYSE (BX). Owns many portfolio companies with consumer brands, but the firm itself is investor-facing.

wiki.title: Blackstone Inc.
wiki.text: Blackstone Inc. is an American alternative investment management company based in New York City. It was founded in 1985 as a mergers and acquisitions firm by Peter Peterson and Stephen Schwarzman, who had previously worked together at Lehman Brothers. Blackstone's private equity business has been one of the largest investors in leveraged buyouts in the last three decades, while its real estate business has actively acquired commercial real estate across the globe. Blackstone is also active in credit, infrastructure, hedge funds, secondaries, growth equity, and insurance solutions. As of September 2025, Blackstone had $1.2 trillion in total as

about: CBRE Group is the world's largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, based in Dallas, offering leasing, sales, property and facilities management, project management, valuation and investment management to occupiers and investors in over 100 countries with about 140,000 employees. Revenue is above $35 billion. Listed on the NYSE (CBRE) and a Fortune 500 company. B2B brand, well recognised by business audiences.

wiki.title: CBRE Group
wiki.what: US commercial real estate services and investment company
wiki.text: CBRE Group, Inc. is an American commercial real estate services and investment firm, with corporate headquarters in Dallas, Texas, and global financial headquarters at Lever House in Midtown Manhattan. It is the world's largest commercial real estate services and investment firm based on 2025 revenue.

about: Simon Property Group is an Indianapolis-based REIT and the largest US mall operator, owning premium malls and outlets such as Roosevelt Field, King of Prussia and Premium Outlets, with international interests in Asia and Europe. Tenants are major retailers; revenue is above $6 billion in rent. Listed on the NYSE (SPG). Its malls are visited by tens of millions of shoppers, giving real consumer reach.

wiki.title: Simon Property Group
wiki.text: Simon Property Group, Inc. is an American real estate investment trust that invests in shopping malls, outlet centers, and community/lifestyle centers. It is the largest owner of shopping malls in the United States and is headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. As of June 9, 2026, it owned interests in 235 properties.

about: Five Holdings is a Dubai-based real estate and hospitality investment firm, owner of FIVE Hotels and Resorts brands including FIVE Palm Jumeirah, FIVE Jumeirah Village and Zurich properties, with a boutique lifestyle focus. Crunchbase shows about $1 billion in funding. Consumer-facing hospitality brand with a strong nightlife and event profile in Dubai.

ROSHN is a Riyadh based Saudi real estate developer owned by the Public Investment Fund (PIF), building large residential communities such as Sarai in Riyadh, Warefa and the Alarous districts, as part of Saudi Vision 2030 housing goals. It sells homes and community facilities to Saudi families, and is already a sports sponsor: it is title sponsor of the Roshn Saudi League and a global partner of Formula 1. Funding shown is about SAR 11 billion. It is a prominent state-backed consumer property brand.

wiki.title: Roshn
wiki.what: Saudi Arabian real estate development group
wiki.text: Roshn is a Saudi Arabian real estate development group established in August 2020 by the Public Investment Fund (PIF) as one of its giga-projects. It aims to develop residential communities and support the goals of Saudi Vision 2030 by increasing homeownership among Saudi citizens across the Kingdom.

about: Tishman Speyer is a New York based real estate developer, owner and operator of offices, residential, retail and mixed-use projects around the world, including Rockefeller Center, which it owns, the Chrysler Building previously and projects across Europe, Asia and Latin America. Founded in 1978 and led by Rob Speyer, it manages tens of billions of dollars of assets and runs investment funds. It is private. It is a prominent B2B real estate brand with a visible presence in global cities.

wiki.title: Tishman Speyer
wiki.text: Tishman Speyer is an American multinational corporation based at 45 Rockefeller Plaza in Midtown Manhattan. The conglomerate invests in high-profile real estate properties, has developed multiple buildings around the world, and owns numerous famous buildings and land plots, including the Chrysler Building and Rockefeller Center.

about: Omniyat is a Dubai luxury real estate developer, founded in 2005 by Mahdi Amjad, known for high-end towers in Business Bay and Downtown Dubai such as The Opus (designed by Zaha Hadid), One Palm, Dorchester Collection residences and Langham. Customers are high-net-worth buyers and investors in Dubai, and revenue comes from property sales. Privately held. Premium brand in the Gulf property market with a luxury-lifestyle profile.

WeWork is a New York flexible workspace company that rents shared office space, private offices and memberships to freelancers, startups and corporates, with locations in cities around the world. Founded in 2010 by Adam Neumann, it was backed by SoftBank, abandoned its 2019 IPO, listed via SPAC in 2021, and filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy in 2023. It emerged as a private company in 2024. Strong brand awareness among professionals.

wiki.title: WeWork
wiki.text: WeWork Inc. is an American company headquartered in New York City that provides coworking spaces, including physical and virtual shared spaces, in approximately 600 buildings in 125 cities.

about: Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield is a Paris-based developer and operator of flagship shopping destinations, owning malls such as Westfield London, Westfield Stratford City, Westfield Forum des Halles, Westfield Century City, and Westfield Mall of Scandinavia, across Europe and the US, plus offices and convention centres. Revenue is mainly from rents on retailers, with hundreds of millions of annual visitors. Listed on Euronext Paris and Amsterdam under URW. Strong consumer-facing mall brand, with an advertising and sponsorship platform.

wiki.title: Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield
wiki.text: Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield SE is a multinational commercial real estate company headquartered in Paris, France. It owns, develops and operates large shopping centres in Europe and the United States, most of them under the Westfield brand, together with office buildings in Paris and, through Viparis, the main convention and exhibition centres of the Paris region.

about: Property Finder is a Dubai-based online real estate marketplace for the Middle East and North Africa, listing homes and offices for sale or rent in the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Bahrain and Egypt. It earns advertising and subscription fees from agents and developers. Backed by investors such as Permira and Dubai-linked funds. A well-known consumer brand in the Gulf with strong marketing.

Localiza is Brazil's largest car rental company, headquartered in Belo Horizonte, listed on the B3 exchange in Sao Paulo (RENT3), and one of the largest in Latin America. It rents cars to consumers and companies, runs long-term fleet outsourcing and the Seminovos used car retail business, and merged with rival Unidas in 2022, creating a fleet of more than 600,000 vehicles. Founded in 1973. Strong consumer brand in Brazil with a heavy retail presence, plus Localiza Meoo and Hertz franchise operations.

wiki.title: Localiza
wiki.text: Localiza is a Brazilian car rental company founded in 1973 in Belo Horizonte and is the biggest car rental in Latin America and one of the largest in the world by size of the fleet and market capitalization.

about: Global commercial real estate services and investment firm headquartered in Chicago, listed on the NYSE (JLL). It advises and manages property for corporate occupiers, landlords and investors, covering leasing, capital markets, property and facilities management, project development and investment management. It operates in more than 80 countries with roughly 100,000 people and about $23 billion in annual revenue, and was formed by the 1999 merger of Jones Lang Wootton and LaSalle Partners. B2B brand, well known in the property industry but little consumer awareness.

wiki.title: JLL (company)
wiki.text: Jones Lang LaSalle Incorporated (JLL) is a global real estate services company headquartered in Chicago. The company has offices in 80 countries. It offers investment management services worldwide, including services to institutional and retail investors, and to high-net-worth individuals, as well as technology products through JLL Technologies, and venture capital investments through its PropTech fund, JLL Spark. The company is ranked 175 on the Fortune 500.

about: Mitsui Fudosan is Japan's largest property developer, headquartered in Tokyo and listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange (8801), owning offices, malls (LaLaport, Mitsui Outlet Park), hotels, and condominium developments in Japan, the US, Europe and Asia. Revenue is about 2.4 trillion yen. Founded in 1941. A well-known consumer-facing brand in Japan, and a sports sponsor.

wiki.title: Mitsui Fudosan
wiki.text: The Mitsui Fudosan Co., Ltd. is a major Japanese real estate developer with properties located globally. Mitsui Fudosan is one of the core companies of Mitsui Group.

about: Ayala Corporation is the Philippines' oldest conglomerate, based in Makati, with interests in real estate (Ayala Land), banking (Bank of the Philippine Islands), telecommunications (Globe), water (Manila Water), energy (ACEN), automotive and industrial technology, healthcare and business process outsourcing (IntegraGroup). Revenue exceeds 300 billion pesos. It is controlled by the Zobel de Ayala family and listed on the Philippine Stock Exchange (AC). Very well known in the Philippines, with wide consumer reach through group brands.

wiki.title: Ayala Corporation
wiki.text: Ayala Corporation is a Philippine diversified conglomerate. Founded in 1834 by Domingo Ureta Roxas and Antonio de Ayala during Spanish colonial rule, it is the Philippines' oldest and largest conglomerate. The company has a portfolio of diverse business interests, including investments in retail, education, real estate, banking, telecommunications, water infrastructure, renewable energy, electronics, information technology, automotive, healthcare, management, and business process outsourcing.

about: Sobha Realty is a Dubai-based luxury real estate developer, the UAE arm of Indian-founded Sobha group, known for the master-planned Sobha Hartland community in Mohammed Bin Rashid City, plus Sobha One, Sobha Sanctuary, and Sobha Seahaven. It develops and sells homes and villas to buyers and investors and does its own construction and manufacturing. Founded by PNC Menon in 1976 in India. Privately held by the Menon family. Recognised UAE property brand, with regular sports and event sponsorships.

wiki.title: Sobha (company)
wiki.text: Sobha Limited is a multinational real estate developer with its headquarters in Dubai, United Arab Emirates and a corporate office in Bengaluru, India.

about: Binghatti is a Dubai property developer known for distinctive, design-led residential towers across Dubai, including projects branded with luxury partners such as Bugatti Residences, Jacob & Co and Mercedes-Benz Places. It sells apartments to local and international buyers and investors, and is a large builder of high-rise towers in the emirate. Founded by the Binghatti family and led by Muhammad Binghatti, it has raised debt in the form of sukuk bonds. Strongly branded, marketing-led developer in the UAE with visible billboards and sports and events sponsorship appetite.
